verdictEs: ProSettings.com si quieres DB grande de configs detallados con gear list completo de cada pro. SensConverter.app si necesitas convertir sensibilidad entre juegos (Apex ↔ Valorant/CS2) o filtrar pros por role/region. Complementarios — los pros usan ambos en su workflow de copying configs.
verdictEn: ProSettings.com if you want a large DB of detailed configs with full gear list per pro. SensConverter.app if you need to convert sensitivity between games (Apex ↔ Valorant/CS2) or filter pros by role/region. Complementary — pros use both in their config-copying workflow.

useCases.labelEs: Copiar config completo de un pro específico
useCases.labelEn: Copy a specific pro's full config
useCases.reasonEs: ProSettings tiene DB de 100+ pros con detalle granular: in-game sens, DPI, ADS multiplier por scope, keybinds, video settings, gear completo. SensConverter cubre 50+ pros con menos detalle gear-wise.
useCases.reasonEn: ProSettings has a 100+ pro DB with granular detail: in-game sens, DPI, per-scope ADS multiplier, keybinds, video settings, full gear. SensConverter covers 50+ pros with less gear-wise detail.

useCases.labelEs: Convertir sens desde Valorant/CS2 a Apex
useCases.labelEn: Convert sens from Valorant/CS2 to Apex
useCases.reasonEs: SensConverter es la herramienta dedicated a esto. Input source game settings, output Apex equivalent manteniendo cm/360 consistency. ProSettings no tiene esta calc.
useCases.reasonEn: SensConverter is the dedicated tool for this. Input source game settings, output Apex equivalent maintaining cm/360 consistency. ProSettings has no such calc.

useCases.labelEs: Filtrar pros por role (IGL, entry, support)
useCases.labelEn: Filter pros by role (IGL, entry, support)
useCases.reasonEs: SensConverter agrupa pros por role y region con filtros granulares. ProSettings es más list-based sin filter por role.
useCases.reasonEn: SensConverter groups pros by role and region with granular filters. ProSettings is more list-based with no role filter.

useCases.labelEs: Investigar gear (mouse, keyboard, monitor) antes de comprar
useCases.labelEn: Research gear (mouse, keyboard, monitor) before buying
useCases.reasonEs: ProSettings tiene gear list extensiva por pro: mouse model, mousepad, monitor specs, keyboard, headset. SensConverter cubre algo de gear pero menos detalle.
useCases.reasonEn: ProSettings has an extensive per-pro gear list: mouse model, mousepad, monitor specs, keyboard, headset. SensConverter covers some gear but with less detail.

useCases.labelEs: Calcular eDPI rápido sin lookup individual
useCases.labelEn: Calculate eDPI quickly without individual lookup
useCases.reasonEs: SensConverter tiene calc de eDPI standalone. ProSettings expone eDPI in profile pages pero requires navegación.
useCases.reasonEn: SensConverter has a standalone eDPI calc. ProSettings exposes eDPI in profile pages but requires navigation.
